record.name: The Gambia
record.summary: No qualifying institute or commitment identified. The National Misinformation and Disinformation Response Centre uses AI to check public information; the reported mandate does not include evaluating advanced AI models.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

Re-ran searches in English for a government-designated institute that evaluates advanced models, or a commitment, proposal or study naming one. No qualifying institute or commitment was identified; results described the Digital Economy Master Plan 2024-2034, the 2025 data protection act and AI training initiatives, with no national AI strategy found. Kept low: the ministry site failed certificate verification and its data-governance presentation returned HTTP 403, so no primary governance source is cited. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in English; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The Lawyers Hub desk-research profile was read, but independence of its underlying citations from the paired national or press source was not verified. It is not counted as a second evidence origin. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.

related_bodies.name: Information Commission
related_bodies.role: It oversees data protection; the retained secondary profile identifies no explicit AI evaluation mandate.

related_bodies.name: National Misinformation and Disinformation Response Centre
related_bodies.role: It was launched under the Ministry of Information in April 2026 to detect, verify and respond to false information; no advanced AI model-evaluation designation was found.

record.notes: An earlier exploratory Wolof-term search produced no usable official result and is not treated as complete local-language coverage. Read the state broadcaster report of the National Misinformation and Disinformation Response Centre launch (gm-grts-nmdrc-2026), including the Vice-President statement and demonstration description. Content verification using AI does not establish a mandate to test general-purpose or frontier models. Search-index text for the government Digital Economy Master Plan describes a National Artificial Intelligence Research Center for applied health, agriculture and education, but full PDFs on mocde.gov.gm and data.gov.gm were not readable: timeout/502 errors, a single attempt to retrieve a text copy of the 2023 PDF failed, and a direct request to the data.gov.gm PDF failed certificate verification. This unresolved applied-research lead is not counted as an AISI. The September 2025 UN statement PDF and Ministry of Foreign Affairs AI-governance article also failed direct retrieval. These unread documents are not cited as newly verified evidence. The former blanket claim that no AI body was found is removed.
